notes: Original generated effects. Playback normalizes peaks and trims leading silence. Existing shotgun samples preserved.

samples.name: rifle
samples.prompt: Single dry automatic rifle gunshot, sharp mechanical crack and brittle volcanic glass snap, short punchy bass, compact dry tail. Isolated first person game sound, immediate attack, no music or voice.

samples.name: bow-fire
samples.prompt: One taut bowstring snapping followed immediately by a swift fiery magical arrow whoosh, crisp string twang and hot rushing air. Powerful dry close sound, no music, no voice, no electronic beeps.

samples.name: bow-void
samples.prompt: A single magical bow firing a dark energy arrow, sharp bowstring snap with a deep rushing vacuum and crackling violet energy tail. Immediate dry attack, no music or voices, no beeps.

samples.name: explosion
samples.prompt: One heavy magical explosive impact, deep tight thunderous boom with crunchy stone debris and brief burning energy tail. Isolated game sound, immediate impact, no music or voices.

samples.name: macuahuitl-swing
samples.prompt: One powerful heavy wooden sword swung from right to left, broad fast rushing air with a low blade whistle. Starts immediately and peaks after a quarter second. No impact, no music, no voices.

samples.name: flames
samples.prompt: A one second burst of pressurized magical flames from hands: immediate ignition whoosh, fierce dense roaring fire, ends with a quick ember hiss. Dry close perspective, no music, no speech, no beeps.

samples.name: espinario
samples.prompt: Single compact pneumatic poison dart SMG shot, wooden clack, compressed air spit, bone needle snap.

samples.name: sniper
samples.prompt: One single heavy anti-materiel sniper rifle shot, immediate sharp crack, deep bass concussion, metallic receiver slam and brief violet-energy tail. No reload, music or voices.
